Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset type: ONE transparent 2D game sprite, an EMPTY communal cafeteria table with two attached long benches. Reference image is approved final cafeteria concept; match one of its FIVE vertical table groups exactly in material, camera and shape.
Draw a single worn honey-brown rectangular wooden tabletop, long axis VERTICAL / north-south on canvas, two long narrow wooden benches at its LEFT and RIGHT sides running parallel to tabletop, slim charcoal steel frame and small legs. High-angle orthographic top-down illustrated game camera, clearly visible tabletop, just a shallow SOUTH-facing front edge with legs under it, no isometric diagonal edges, no foreshortened horizontal table. Top and bottom sides horizontal, left and right vertical. Combined top-view plan aspect width:depth about 150:215, overall sprite roughly 150:230 after slight south elevation. Tabletop width ~80, benches width18 each, narrow gap8 between bench and tabletop. Distinctive chipped tabletop edges and subtle wood grain matching concept, crisp dark outline, uniform muted factory game painted texture, restrained wear and soft highlights. EMPTY surface: no tray, cups, cutlery, food or people. True transparent alpha background; object isolated centered with generous margin; no scenery, floor, tile grid, text, drop shadow on ground, label, perspective gradient, extra table, UI, solid background. Do NOT draw table as horizontal then rotate; render correct vertical camera directly. High resolution to preserve sharp source details at 150 world-unit width.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE reusable transparent production sprite: cafeteria WALL MATERIAL STRIP. Reference is approved cafeteria, match its thin flat ivory plaster wall with lower muted grey-olive ceramic tile wainscot and dark steel edging.
Draw a single very WIDE STRAIGHT horizontal wall strip, straight-on orthographic upper-surface + shallow front elevation for high-angle 2D factory game. Aspect roughly 4:1, entire face axis-aligned rectangular. From TOP to BOTTOM: narrow 7% dark muted-steel horizontal cap with light highlight, ivory painted flat plaster band taking 50%, lower half square grey-olive ceramic tiles in three clean even horizontal rows, thin charcoal wall-base rail. Slight paint wear, subtle glaze and edge scratches, clear ink outlines, tile joint linework sharp. No massive rounded stone coping, no individual beige masonry blocks. Entire strip is flat and constant height; grout lines correctly parallel. The left and right ends terminate exactly flush with no metal endposts or shadows, since it will repeat in modular connections. Do not taper or draw sidewalls. No corners in the source strip, no windows/doors/signs, no floor, no plants or fixtures, no text, no ground shadow. True transparent alpha around strip, large clear top and bottom margins and small side margins, source strip remains solid/opaque inside. Render large landscape source, crisp painted visual texture without grain or noise.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE transparent production 2D game sprite: very wide north-wall kitchen BACKLINE equipment bank matching approved cafeteria reference. High-angle top-down orthographic axis-aligned game camera, straight horizontal long row, no isometric diagonal. Render elevated appliance top surfaces with shallow SOUTH-facing fronts.
A continuous bank about 9:1 width:ground depth, overall drawn silhouette about 7:1 width:height: at left a simple grey-blue tall storage cupboard and stacked metal tray rack, then modest rice kettle, low stove/closed stock pots, narrow stainless preparation area, at right a metal double washing sink and short utensils rack/closed cupboard. Plain industrial prison food kitchen, cheap well-used practical appliances, NO lavish food display. Keep highest cabinets to ends, nothing towering giant above row. All equipment in one straight continuous horizontal band with consistent depth and top alignment, rear edge flush for wall placement. No staff, no wall behind, no floor, no doors/windows, no service counter in front, no labels/text, no background, no ground drop shadow. True transparent alpha margins, isolated source PNG. Large landscape source.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated transparent 2D game sprite: wide cafeteria serving COUNTER EMPTY BODY ONLY, matching approved final concept's grey low stainless counter. High-angle orthographic game camera with rectangular horizontal top surface and a shallow SOUTH-facing cabinet front, all edges horizontal/vertical, absolutely no isometric diamond.

No attached rear stove/storage area, no background floor/wall, no shadow baked on floor. True transparent RGBA. Food and props will be separate layered sprites. Large landscape PNG.
